network.blockBody: Blocks {app} from connecting to port {port} with a MI CS filter in Windows' filtering engine. The filter persists after MI CS closes, and removing it needs the same administrator.
network.blockCountryHint: Creates a MICS-BLOCK-<CC> rule from rules/blocklists/<CC>.cidr
network.blocked: Blocked {app} on port {port} — it stays blocked after MI CS closes.
network.defaultDenyOn: ON — all outbound traffic blocked unless a rule allows it (L1)
network.noBlock: This row has no peer port to match (a UDP socket or a listener), so there is no exact filter to write. Block the program from the Firewall tab instead.
network.noRules: No MICS-* rules yet. Rules created from MI CS appear in wf.msc with the MICS- prefix.
